claims.text: Under Article 7(3)2 of the Act on Reporting and Using Specified Financial Transaction Information, a VASP's registration can be rejected or revoked if it does not conduct customer deposits/withdrawals through a real-name verified account.
Upbit's partner bank is K-Bank, which generally opens accounts only for Korean citizens; even resident foreigners are routinely turned away unless they hold F-5 or F-6 visas.

On May 4, 2026 at Consensus Miami, Dunamu and the Optimism Foundation signed a non-binding MoU under which GIWA is expected to become the first chain on OP Enterprise's Self-Managed tier; the announcement names no mainnet date.

Optimism's own language: 'No platform takes a cut of everything that moves,' and 'fee savings are a side benefit'; Self-Managed means the operator runs its own sequencer while the Foundation provides support.
Upbit held 71.6% of Korea's won-based crypto trading volume in H1 2025 (833 trillion won / ~$642B), per FSS data via Seoul Kyungjae.

Dunamu's FY2025 consolidated revenue fell 10.0% YoY to KRW 1.5578T (~$1.03B); operating profit dropped 26.7% to KRW 869.3B; net profit fell 27.9% to KRW 708.9B; trading commissions were 98.3% of revenue.
Naver Financial-Dunamu merger: 1 Dunamu share to 2.5422618 Naver Financial shares, ~87.56 million new shares issued, deal valued near $10.28B (~KRW 15.13T).

The merger's shareholder vote/closing moved from May 22/June 30 to August 18/September 30 to November 19/December 31 2026, driven by KFTC antitrust review, an FSS correction order tied to disclosure omissions, and DABA.

GASOK offers up to $100,000 total per team ($20,000 initial grant plus up to $80,000 in KPI-based milestone bonuses), five-phase schedule (Screening, MVP Build, Productize, Demoday, Growth), applications extended to July 31, 2026.
Base's TVL climbed from $2.1B in October 2024 to $11.2B by April 2026, with ~12.89M daily transactions and ~382,500 daily active users by early 2026.
Mid-2026 Total Value Secured figures put Base at $11.49B (~40% share) and Arbitrum One at $10.12B (~39% share) across roughly 73 tracked rollups.
Kraken's Ink TVL surged roughly 3,800% in two weeks after Tydro launched on October 15, 2025, crossing $500 million by January 6, 2026.
Robinhood's innovation was commission-free mobile trading funded by payment-for-order-flow, breaking a fee/minimum-balance barrier: $0 per trade against $7-10 incumbents charged.
Robinhood drew a $65M SEC settlement in 2020 for misleading customers about execution quality, with $34.1M in identified customer harm.
Robinhood had grown to roughly 28.5M funded customer accounts by July 2026.
A standard Superchain-member OP Stack chain commits 2.5% of net sequencer revenue OR 15% of sequencer profit, whichever is greater, to the Optimism Collective under the 'Law of Chains.'
Relay's own testnet-chains API, queried directly for this article, returns only Base Sepolia and Sepolia as of the research date; GIWA and GIWA Sepolia are absent.
GIWA's own official documentation states plainly: 'GIWA Mainnet is currently under development. See you soon,' with GIWA Sepolia testnet on chain ID 91342.
